verdict.rationale: Poke documents its own Reminders feature, which lets users set reminders naturally, and Recipes, which let users "set up automations." It also describes itself as a "proactive" assistant that messages users back on their messaging channels. This suggests time-triggered and automated behavior, but nothing explicitly documents scheduling recurring or one-off tasks that execute work and report results back. missing for 10: explicit scheduled or recurring task execution docs, one-off timed task runs that return results, details on how automations are triggered on a schedule, independent or hands-on corroboration.
